origins.murmol.human.name: Human
origins.murmol.human.description: The beginning of everything. No powers, but you may switch to any form at the Summoning Platform or with form souls.
origins.murmol.luohong.name: Petalfall Vernal
origins.murmol.luohong.description: A shrunken blossom beast: faster movement, attack speed and jumps, but reduced max health.
origins.murmol.chen_huang.name: Chenhuang
origins.murmol.chen_huang.description: A deer-like divine beast: tougher hide, more health, and steady steps that shrug off knockback.
origins.murmol.moss_beast.name: Moss Beast
origins.murmol.moss_beast.description: Child of caves: movement and mining bonuses underground, sluggish in daylight; sturdy and knockback-resistant.
origins.murmol.silkmoth.name: Silkmoth
origins.murmol.silkmoth.description: A hovering night-flyer: soar through the sky, thrive at night, but weak and slow in daylight.
origins.murmol.komainu.name: Komainu
origins.murmol.komainu.description: A guardian beast: standing still turns you to living stone — unnoticed and resilient; meditate on a stone seat to recover.
origins.murmol.wenyao.name: Wenyao
origins.murmol.wenyao.description: A flying fish: breathe and swim with ease, even leap from water — but suffocate on land, where every step is a struggle.
